posts.author: NousResearch
posts.text:
Hermes profiles are now portable and shareable:

Run /export to save a profile as a single file with credentials stripped: skills, memory, persona, crons, plugins, settings, desktop themes and layouts.

Then /import loads the profile file, and your setup is up and running. https://t.co/NF3PuR2Yb4
